//go:build integration
// +build integration

package integration

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/infrastructure/persistence/postgres"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"
)

func TestObjectiveEvidenceBuildsReplaySafeMasteryProjection(t *testing.T) {
	pool := getTestDBPool(t)
	defer pool.Close()
	ctx := context.Background()
	studentID := uuid.NewString()
	target := domain.LearningTargetRef{Type: domain.LearningTargetCapability, Key: "go.errors.wrap", Version: "v1"}
	defer cleanupMasteryStudent(t, pool, studentID)

	taskOne := uuid.NewString()
	firstAssistance := closeAndAssistApplication(t, pool, studentID, taskOne, target, domain.TeacherSupportIndependent)
	secondAssistance := closeAndAssistApplication(t, pool, studentID, taskOne, target, domain.TeacherSupportIndependent)
	thirdAssistance := closeAndAssistApplication(t, pool, studentID, uuid.NewString(), target, domain.TeacherSupportIndependent)

	var state string
	var masteryScore, confidence float64
	var independentCount, assistedCount, failureCount, evidenceCount int
	err := pool.QueryRow(ctx, `
SELECT state, mastery_score, confidence, independent_success_count,
       assisted_success_count, failure_count, evidence_count
FROM student_target_mastery
WHERE student_id = $1 AND target_type = $2 AND target_key = $3 AND target_version = $4
`, studentID, target.Type, target.Key, target.Version).Scan(
		&state,
		&masteryScore,
		&confidence,
		&independentCount,
		&assistedCount,
		&failureCount,
		&evidenceCount,
	)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("load mastery projection: %v", err)
	}
	if state != string(domain.TargetMasteryMastered) || masteryScore != 1 || confidence != 0.6 {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected mastery projection state=%s score=%v confidence=%v", state, masteryScore, confidence)
	}
	if independentCount != 3 || assistedCount != 0 || failureCount != 0 || evidenceCount != 3 {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected mastery counts independent=%d assisted=%d failure=%d evidence=%d", independentCount, assistedCount, failureCount, evidenceCount)
	}

	var targetEvidenceCount, auditCount int
	if err := pool.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT count(*) FROM student_learning_action_target_evidence WHERE student_id = $1`, studentID).Scan(&targetEvidenceCount); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("count target evidence: %v", err)
	}
	if err := pool.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT count(*) FROM student_target_mastery_audit WHERE student_id = $1`, studentID).Scan(&auditCount); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("count mastery audit: %v", err)
	}
	if targetEvidenceCount != 3 || auditCount != 3 {
		t.Fatalf("target evidence=%d audit=%d, want 3 each", targetEvidenceCount, auditCount)
	}

	repository := &postgres.LearningEvidenceRepoPG{Pool: pool}
	listed, err := repository.ListStudentTargetMastery(ctx, studentID, []domain.LearningTargetRef{
		target,
		{Type: domain.LearningTargetConcept, Key: "go.interfaces"},
	})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("list target mastery: %v", err)
	}
	if len(listed) != 1 || listed[0].State != domain.TargetMasteryMastered {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected stored mastery list: %+v", listed)
	}
	applied, err := repository.ApplyTeacherAssistance(ctx, firstAssistance)
	if err != nil || applied {
		t.Fatalf("duplicate assistance result applied=%v err=%v", applied, err)
	}

	_ = secondAssistance
	_ = thirdAssistance
}

func TestObjectiveEvidenceRejectsAssistanceOutsideFrozenTargets(t *testing.T) {
	pool := getTestDBPool(t)
	defer pool.Close()
	ctx := context.Background()
	studentID := uuid.NewString()
	target := domain.LearningTargetRef{Type: domain.LearningTargetConcept, Key: "go.errors"}
	defer cleanupMasteryStudent(t, pool, studentID)

	answer, action, closure := closeApplication(t, pool, studentID, uuid.NewString(), target)
	assistance := independentAssistance(t, action, closure)
	assistance.Observations[0].Target.Key = "go.interfaces"
	repository := &postgres.LearningEvidenceRepoPG{Pool: pool}
	applied, err := repository.ApplyTeacherAssistance(ctx, assistance)
	if applied || !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrEvidenceContract) {
		t.Fatalf("mismatched assistance result applied=%v err=%v", applied, err)
	}

	var inboxCount int
	if err := pool.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT count(*) FROM student_integration_inbox WHERE event_id = $1`, assistance.EventID).Scan(&inboxCount); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("count rejected inbox event: %v", err)
	}
	if inboxCount != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("rejected assistance left %d inbox rows", inboxCount)
	}
	_ = answer
}

func TestGuidedApplicationRemainsPracticed(t *testing.T) {
	pool := getTestDBPool(t)
	defer pool.Close()
	ctx := context.Background()
	studentID := uuid.NewString()
	target := domain.LearningTargetRef{Type: domain.LearningTargetConcept, Key: "go.interfaces"}
	defer cleanupMasteryStudent(t, pool, studentID)

	closeAndAssistApplication(t, pool, studentID, uuid.NewString(), target, domain.TeacherSupportGuided)
	var state string
	var masteryScore float64
	var independentCount, assistedCount int
	if err := pool.QueryRow(ctx, `
SELECT state, mastery_score, independent_success_count, assisted_success_count
FROM student_target_mastery
WHERE student_id = $1 AND target_type = $2 AND target_key = $3 AND target_version = ''
`, studentID, target.Type, target.Key).Scan(&state, &masteryScore, &independentCount, &assistedCount); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("load guided mastery: %v", err)
	}
	if state != string(domain.TargetMasteryPracticed) || masteryScore != 0.5 || independentCount != 0 || assistedCount != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected guided mastery state=%s score=%v independent=%d assisted=%d", state, masteryScore, independentCount, assistedCount)
	}
}

func closeAndAssistApplication(
	t *testing.T,
	pool *pgxpool.Pool,
	studentID string,
	taskID string,
	target domain.LearningTargetRef,
	support domain.TeacherSupportContext,
) domain.TeacherAssistance {
	t.Helper()
	_, action, closure := closeApplication(t, pool, studentID, taskID, target)
	assistance := independentAssistance(t, action, closure)
	if support == domain.TeacherSupportGuided {
		assistance.SupportContext = support
		assistance.Observations[0].Kind = domain.TeacherObservationGuidedContext
	}
	normalized, err := domain.NewTeacherAssistance(assistance)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("normalize teacher assistance: %v", err)
	}
	repository := &postgres.LearningEvidenceRepoPG{Pool: pool}
	applied, err := repository.ApplyTeacherAssistance(context.Background(), normalized)
	if err != nil || !applied {
		t.Fatalf("apply teacher assistance result applied=%v err=%v", applied, err)
	}
	return normalized
}

func closeApplication(
	t *testing.T,
	pool *pgxpool.Pool,
	studentID string,
	taskID string,
	target domain.LearningTargetRef,
) (domain.StudentTaskAnswer, domain.StudentLearningAction, domain.IntegrationEvent) {
	t.Helper()
	ctx := context.Background()
	now := time.Now().UTC()
	answer := domain.StudentTaskAnswer{
		ID:        uuid.NewString(),
		StudentID: studentID,
		TaskID:    taskID,
		StartedAt: now.Add(-time.Minute),
		Status:    domain.StudentTaskAnswerStatusInProgress,
		CreatedAt: now.Add(-time.Minute),
		UpdatedAt: now.Add(-time.Minute),
	}
	action, err := domain.NewStudentLearningAction(domain.StudentLearningAction{
		ID:                  uuid.NewString(),
		StudentTaskAnswerID: answer.ID,
		StudentID:           studentID,
		TaskID:              taskID,
		ContextType:         domain.LearningContextLessonTask,
		ContextID:           taskID,
		LearningTargets:     []domain.LearningTargetRef{target},
		EvidenceClass:       domain.LearningEvidenceApplication,
		OpenedAt:            answer.StartedAt,
	})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("create learning action: %v", err)
	}
	lifecycle := &postgres.LearningActionLifecycleRepoPG{Pool: pool}
	answer, action, err = lifecycle.CreateAnswer(ctx, answer, nil, action)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("create answer/action: %v", err)
	}
	closedAt := now
	answer.Status = domain.StudentTaskAnswerStatusPassed
	answer.EndedAt = &closedAt
	answer.UpdatedAt = closedAt
	closure, err := domain.NewLearningActionClosedEvent(uuid.NewString(), action, closedAt)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("create action closure: %v", err)
	}
	action.Outcome = domain.LearningActionPassed
	action.OutcomePolicyVersion = domain.MasteryPolicyVersion
	if err := lifecycle.CloseAnswer(ctx, answer, action, closure); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("close answer/action: %v", err)
	}
	action.ClosedAt = &closedAt
	return answer, action, closure
}

func independentAssistance(t *testing.T, action domain.StudentLearningAction, closure domain.IntegrationEvent) domain.TeacherAssistance {
	t.Helper()
	assistance, err := domain.NewTeacherAssistance(domain.TeacherAssistance{
		EventID:          uuid.NewString(),
		StudentID:        action.StudentID,
		CorrelationID:    action.ID,
		CausationID:      closure.EventID,
		LearningActionID: action.ID,
		ContextType:      action.ContextType,
		ContextID:        action.ContextID,
		SupportContext:   domain.TeacherSupportIndependent,
		Observations: []domain.TeacherAssistanceObservation{
			{Target: action.LearningTargets[0], Kind: domain.TeacherObservationIndependentContext},
		},
		PolicyVersion: "teacher-assistance-v1",
		OccurredAt:    closure.OccurredAt.Add(time.Second),
	})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("create teacher assistance: %v", err)
	}
	return assistance
}

func cleanupMasteryStudent(t *testing.T, pool *pgxpool.Pool, studentID string) {
	t.Helper()
	ctx := context.Background()
	statements := []string{
		`DELETE FROM student_target_mastery_audit WHERE student_id = $1`,
		`DELETE FROM student_target_mastery WHERE student_id = $1`,
		`DELETE FROM student_learning_evidence WHERE student_id = $1`,
		`DELETE FROM student_learning_action_assistance WHERE student_id = $1`,
		`DELETE FROM student_integration_inbox WHERE student_id = $1`,
		`DELETE FROM student_outbox WHERE student_id = $1`,
		`DELETE FROM student_task_answer WHERE student_id = $1`,
	}
	for _, statement := range statements {
		if _, err := pool.Exec(ctx, statement, studentID); err != nil {
			t.Errorf("cleanup mastery student: %v", err)
		}
	}
}
